  Oracle offers the highest-performing cloud services at the lowest cost. That's why so many of the

  The demand for cloud infrastructure for AI training and inferencing greatly exceeds supply. In
  response to this shortage, Oracle is building AI cloud capacity as quickly as we can.
  
  [Learn more][22]

  Get the same low price everywhere.

  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## There's nothing to install. No credit card required. Free for 30 days

[ Try for free ][85]

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## 30 Years of Pioneering Data

Trusted expertise at the intersection of human intelligence and AI innovation

1996
Early NLP Systems
Speech recognition and language processing — Appen's first steps in building human-labeled datasets
for AI.
2003
Search Relevance
Human evaluation for search quality at scale, powering the first generation of web search ranking
models.
2006
Machine Translation
Statistical translation models requiring multilingual human annotations across 100+ language pairs.
2012
AlexNet Era
Deep learning for computer vision — image annotation and bounding box labeling at industrial scale.
2017
Transformer Models
Attention mechanisms and BERT demanded high-quality sentence-level semantic understanding data.
2020
GPT-3
Large language model training required vast, carefully curated, diverse human-generated text
datasets.
2022
ChatGPT & RLHF
Human feedback alignment — our annotators trained reward models that shaped modern conversational
AI.
2024
Multimodal Foundation Models
Vision, language, and reasoning combined — powering the next generation of frontier AI systems.
2025
Agentic AI
Agentic AI went viral bringing scalable agents to local hardware.

# Human data for frontier AI

The world’s leading AI models are built on more than algorithms, they’re built on human expertise.
We deliver the expert-validated data that trains frontier models, ensuring AI systems understand
nuance, context, and complexity at scale.

[Explore data products][27][Talk to an expert][28]

## Data products to build foundational AI

Six specialised capabilities, each purpose-built for a critical dimension of modern AI development.

[
01

### Frontier Alignment

CoT reasoning traces, SME RLHF, SFT demonstrations and adversarial red teaming for the world’s most
capable models.

Safety

autonomous agents.

500+ global locales.

input modalities.

## 30 Years of Pioneering Data

Trusted expertise at the intersection of human intelligence and AI innovation

1996
Early NLP Systems
Speech recognition and language processing — Appen's first steps in building human-labeled datasets
for AI.
2003
Search Relevance
Human evaluation for search quality at scale, powering the first generation of web search ranking
models.
2006
Machine Translation
Statistical translation models requiring multilingual human annotations across 100+ language pairs.
2012
AlexNet Era
Deep learning for computer vision — image annotation and bounding box labeling at industrial scale.
2017
Transformer Models
Attention mechanisms and BERT demanded high-quality sentence-level semantic understanding data.
2020
GPT-3
Large language model training required vast, carefully curated, diverse human-generated text
datasets.
2022
ChatGPT & RLHF
Human feedback alignment — our annotators trained reward models that shaped modern conversational
AI.
2024
Multimodal Foundation Models
Vision, language, and reasoning combined — powering the next generation of frontier AI systems.
2025
Agentic AI
Agentic AI went viral bringing scalable agents to local hardware.

## Trusted by Leading AI Companies

back in touch with you soon! Have a great day!

[ [Adobe Acrobat][Adobe Acrobat] ][29]

integración de Adobe Acrobat. Conoce todas las funciones y cómo aprovecharlas.

23 de julio de 2026 por [Pedro Lopez][32]
[ [Recortes Amazon inteligencia artificial][Recortes Amazon inteligencia artificial] ][33]

Amazon ha eliminado puestos en su grupo de inteligencia artificial general (AGI) sin precisar
cifras. Conoce los detalles de esta reorganización, los cambios directivos y cómo afecta a su
estrategia de IA.

23 de julio de 2026 por [Pedro Lopez][36]
[ [WhatsApp iPad][WhatsApp iPad] ][37]

¿Cansado de depender del móvil para usar WhatsApp en iPad? Ahora puedes registrarte directamente.
Además, llegan mejoras en el coche, edición de PDF y música en estados. ¡Entérate de todo!

Categorías [Guías][38]

23 de julio de 2026 por [Pedro Lopez][40]
[ [TikTok ecommerce][TikTok ecommerce] ][41]

El Estudio Anual de Redes Sociales 2026 revela que TikTok ecommerce crece en España. Descubre cómo
las marcas aprovechan el social commerce para vender más.

Categorías [TikTok][42]

## [Waze se renueva: modo moto, rutas personalizadas y comandos por voz con inteligencia
## artificial][43]

22 de julio de 2026 por [Pedro Lopez][44]
[ [Waze][Waze] ][45]

Waze incorpora inteligencia artificial para ofrecer rutas personalizadas, modo moto con alertas de
baches y comandos de voz. Conoce todas las novedades que llegan a la app.

Categorías [Guías][46]

## [Google AI Mode se conecta con Canva, YouTube Music e Instacart: ¿qué significa para España?][47]

22 de julio de 2026 por [Pedro Lopez][48]
[ [Canva AI][Canva AI] ][49]

Google integra Canva, YouTube Music e Instacart en su AI Mode de búsqueda. Usuarios en EE.UU. ya
pueden crear listas, diseñar y comprar. ¿Cuándo llegará a España? Te lo contamos.

Categorías [Canva][50]

## [Estafas en WhatsApp: la nueva trampa de la foto de visualización única que ya alerta a
## expertos][51]

22 de julio de 2026 por [Pedro Lopez][52]
[ [estafas en WhatsApp][estafas en WhatsApp] ][53]

¿Recibes una foto de un desconocido en WhatsApp? No la abras. Te explicamos cómo funciona esta
estafa de extorsión y cómo protegerte.

Categorías [Guías][54]

## [Kimi K3: el modelo chino que reduce la brecha en la IA de frontera][55]

21 de julio de 2026 por [Pedro Lopez][56]
[ [IA de frontera][IA de frontera] ][57]

Moonshot AI lanza Kimi K3, un modelo de 2,8 billones de parámetros que supera a Claude Opus 4.8 y
reduce la distancia con Estados Unidos a semanas. Conoce sus claves y su impacto global.

  ## How AI-Enabled Planning Will Improve Your Supply Chain Performance
  
  Extreme volatility, inventory shortages and data overload are all challenges businesses are facing
  when it comes to supply chain planning. AI-enabled planning capabilities can address these
  challenges by improving decision-making, agility, and collaboration across supply chain functions.
  [][96]
  
  ## 2026 Supply Chain Compass: How Supply Chain leaders are navigating complexity
  
  The Supply Chain Compass 2026 report surveys nearly 700 supply chain leaders, exploring how they
  are navigating a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, disruption, and rising expectations.
  While nearly half express strong optimism about the future, the report reveals that this
  confidence is driven by greater visibility, stronger technology adoption, and more integrated,
  data-driven supply chain strategies.
  [][97]
  
  ## Beyond Silos: Evolving to an Enterprise Supply Chain
  
  Incisiv explores the significant transformation underway in modern supply chains, detailing the
  shift away from fragmented processes and point solutions to more agile platforms and collaborative
  workflows. This evolution addresses systemic issues such as inflexibility and disconnected
  communication, enhancing supply chain responsiveness, sustainability, and profitability.

  ## How AI-Enabled Planning Will Improve Your Supply Chain Performance
  
  Extreme volatility, inventory shortages and data overload are all challenges businesses are facing
  when it comes to supply chain planning. AI-enabled planning capabilities can address these
  challenges by improving decision-making, agility, and collaboration across supply chain functions.
  [][96]
  
  ## 2026 Supply Chain Compass: How Supply Chain leaders are navigating complexity
  
  The Supply Chain Compass 2026 report surveys nearly 700 supply chain leaders, exploring how they
  are navigating a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, disruption, and rising expectations.
  While nearly half express strong optimism about the future, the report reveals that this
  confidence is driven by greater visibility, stronger technology adoption, and more integrated,
  data-driven supply chain strategies.
  [][97]
  
  ## Beyond Silos: Evolving to an Enterprise Supply Chain
  
  Incisiv explores the significant transformation underway in modern supply chains, detailing the
  shift away from fragmented processes and point solutions to more agile platforms and collaborative
  workflows. This evolution addresses systemic issues such as inflexibility and disconnected
  communication, enhancing supply chain responsiveness, sustainability, and profitability.

### [RapidScale’s Duane Barnes on How AI Is Transforming Managed Services][9]

Jul 7, 2026

Jul 7, 2026

39 min

Artificial intelligence is compelling managed service providers to rethink where value is created,
shifting the opportunity from resale and token margins to advisory services, implementation,
optimization, lifecycle management, and measurable business outcomes. As customers look for partners
that can turn AI ambition into practical systems, the MSP market is likely to split between
providers with deep expertise and those left supporting yesterday’s model. Duane Barnes, president
of RapidScale, joins Channelnomics’ Larry Walsh on Changing Channels to discuss how AI is reshaping
managed services.

products. To meet those expectations, Lenovo is evolving its channel strategy through Lenovo 360,

mounting tool sprawl, margin pressure, and increasing customer demands for automation and
efficiency. Platform consolidation, workflow orchestration, and AI-driven operations are reshaping
how MSPs scale and compete, while vendors race to position themselves as the operational backbone of
modern service providers. ConnectWise CEO Manny Rivelo joins Channelnomics’ Larry Walsh on *Changing
Channels* to discuss the company’s ASIO platform strategy, the evolution of the MSP business model,
the role of ecosystem integration, and how automation and data-driven operations are redefining the
future of managed services.

Artificial intelligence is compelling managed service providers to rethink where value is created,
shifting the opportunity from resale and token margins to advisory services, implementation,
optimization, lifecycle management, and measurable business outcomes. As customers look for partners
that can turn AI ambition into practical systems, the MSP market is likely to split between
providers with deep expertise and those left supporting yesterday’s model. Duane Barnes, president
of RapidScale, joins Channelnomics’ Larry Walsh on Changing Channels to discuss how AI is reshaping
managed services.

May 12, 2026

The managed services market is entering a new phase as MSPs confront rising operational complexity,
mounting tool sprawl, margin pressure, and increasing customer demands for automation and
efficiency. Platform consolidation, workflow orchestration, and AI-driven operations are reshaping
how MSPs scale and compete, while vendors race to position themselves as the operational backbone of
modern service providers. ConnectWise CEO Manny Rivelo joins Channelnomics’ Larry Walsh on *Changing
Channels* to discuss the company’s ASIO platform strategy, the evolution of the MSP business model,
the role of ecosystem integration, and how automation and data-driven operations are redefining the
future of managed services.

The backup and disaster recovery market has long been viewed as mature and saturated, yet shifting
economics, evolving cyber threats, and partner fatigue are creating an opening for disruption. New
infrastructure capabilities, changing MSP expectations, and rising concerns around vendor
“extraction” models are redefining what partners demand from their technology providers – including
BCDR. Slide, the new MSP-centric backup vendor, aims to shake up the staid segment with new
products, innovations, and commitment to partner collaboration. Co-founders Austin McChord and
Michael Fass join Channelnomics’ Larry Walsh on Changing Channels to discuss the ascent of Slide.

Mar 10, 2026

Enterprise resource planning systems have long been the operational backbone of businesses, but
advances in cloud computing and artificial intelligence are transforming how they are used. AI is
turning ERP from a static system of record into a system of intelligence by applying automation,
analytics, and decision support to the core data that runs a company—finance, supply chains,
procurement, and operations. These changes are also creating new opportunities for partners that
implement and support ERP platforms, as success increasingly depends on industry expertise and the
ability to translate technology into business outcomes. Sanket Akerkar, president and COO of
Acumatica, joins Larry Walsh on Changing Channels to talk about how ERP is cool again.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is CustomGPT.ai?
CustomGPT.ai is the #1 no-code platform for creating custom AI agents for your business. It builds
AI agents powered by advanced large language models (LLMs) tailored to your business content,
without requiring any coding skills.
How does CustomGPT.ai work?

CustomGPT.ai works by transforming your business content into a specialized AI agent – without any
coding required. Simply upload your documents and knowledge base, and the platform automatically
processes this information to create an intelligent assistant that can handle 93% of support and
research questions from your team or customers.

Will CustomGPT.ai train on my data?

No – CustomGPT.ai will never use your data to train any Large Language Model (LLM) or AI in general.
Please see our [Security & Trust][113] center for our best practices.

What is an AI agent?
An AI agent is an app that uses artificial intelligence to perform tasks or provide information
based on your business content. It’s a specialized digital assistant trained on your specific
business content to handle questions and interactions tailored to your organization’s needs.
Is my data safe with CustomGPT.ai?

Your data is fully protected with CustomGPT.ai through enterprise-grade security measures, including
SOC2 Type 2 compliance and GDPR adherence. We employ strict access controls and encryption to
safeguard your information. Learn more about our comprehensive security practices at our [Security &
Trust Center][114].

How does CustomGPT.ai use my data to build an AI agent?
Using a no-code interface, CustomGPT.ai ingests data from sources like your website, helpdesk,
knowledge bases, documents, videos, and podcasts to create a custom AI agent that understands your
business deeply.
How do I get started with CustomGPT.ai, and how do I subscribe to the service?

With our no-code platform, you can set up a custom AI agent trained on your content in just 2
minutes, and then deploy it to answer questions from employees and customers. Choose a [subscription
plan][115] that fits your needs.

What is the pricing model for CustomGPT.ai, and how does it work?

CustomGPT.ai offers Standard ($99/month), Premium ($499/month), and Enterprise (custom pricing)
plans with varying features and capacities, all providing no-code AI agent creation. See more on our
[Pricing][116] page.

How can I provide my content and data to CustomGPT.ai?
Using our no-code interface, upload documents in 1400+ formats, ingest your websites, or use one of
our 100+ integrations like Google Drive, HubSpot, WordPress, Shopify, Wix and many others. You can
also mix and match data from multiple sources without any coding.
Can I white-label and customize the AI agent to my branding and business?
Yes, you can easily personalize the AI agent with your logo, background, and other branding elements
using our no-code platform. Premium and Enterprise plans can remove CustomGPT.ai branding.
Can I build the AI agent with PDF or Microsoft Office or Google Docs files I have?

Yes, CustomGPT.ai’s no-code platform supports **1400+ file formats** including PDFs, Microsoft
Office docs, and Google Docs. In addition, we have over 100+ integrations that allow you to ingest
your content from your website or sources like Shopify, Wix, Notion, HubSpot, etc.

I'm not technical. Can I use this if I can’t code?

Absolutely! CustomGPT.ai is the #1 no-code AI platform and is designed for non-technical users. You
can simply upload documents or input your website in your dashboard to build custom AI agents in
minutes, with no coding or technical expertise required.

What languages are supported by CustomGPT.ai?
CustomGPT.ai supports 92 languages, allowing businesses to create AI agents that understand multiple
languages. This enables companies to deploy support agents that can answer questions from a global
audience in their native language.

plan][115] that fits your needs.

What is the pricing model for CustomGPT.ai, and how does it work?

CustomGPT.ai offers Standard ($99/month), Premium ($499/month), and Enterprise (custom pricing)
plans with varying features and capacities, all providing no-code AI agent creation. See more on our
[Pricing][116] page.

How can I provide my content and data to CustomGPT.ai?
Using our no-code interface, upload documents in 1400+ formats, ingest your websites, or use one of
our 100+ integrations like Google Drive, HubSpot, WordPress, Shopify, Wix and many others. You can
also mix and match data from multiple sources without any coding.
Can I white-label and customize the AI agent to my branding and business?
Yes, you can easily personalize the AI agent with your logo, background, and other branding elements
using our no-code platform. Premium and Enterprise plans can remove CustomGPT.ai branding.
Can I build the AI agent with PDF or Microsoft Office or Google Docs files I have?

Yes, CustomGPT.ai’s no-code platform supports **1400+ file formats** including PDFs, Microsoft
Office docs, and Google Docs. In addition, we have over 100+ integrations that allow you to ingest
your content from your website or sources like Shopify, Wix, Notion, HubSpot, etc.

I'm not technical. Can I use this if I can’t code?

Absolutely! CustomGPT.ai is the #1 no-code AI platform and is designed for non-technical users. You
can simply upload documents or input your website in your dashboard to build custom AI agents in
minutes, with no coding or technical expertise required.

What languages are supported by CustomGPT.ai?
CustomGPT.ai supports 92 languages, allowing businesses to create AI agents that understand multiple
languages. This enables companies to deploy support agents that can answer questions from a global
audience in their native language.

## Setup the Foundation for Enterprise AI

## With the Enterprise AI package at DataToBiz, we bring you closer to what’s next: AI agents,
## chatbots, Co-Pilot, GenAI, and other intelligent automation systems. But only after setting up
## the foundation they rely on. Because without it, none of it scales.

### AI Agents (Single and Multi-Agent Systems)

#### Design and deploy intelligent agents that plan, act, and collaborate across workflows.
* Task automation & orchestration
* Multi-agent system design
* Phase-wise agent development

### Generative AI Systems ( GenAI )

#### Build custom GenAI solutions that go beyond content, communication, and language. Helping true
#### business use cases across teams.
* Custom LLM integrations
* RAG-based knowledge systems
* Enterprise-grade AI copilots

### AI Copilots & Workflow Integration

#### Embed AI directly into your tools, teams, and processes, so productivity becomes native, not
#### forced into the system.
* Internal copilots for teams
* Workflow automation with AI
* Seamless tool & API integrations

### Hyper-customized AI Chatbots

# Transforme Visão em Resultado

Ajudamos empresas a transformar estratégia em impacto, criando crescimento sustentável e mensurável.

[Explore nossas soluções][22]

Soluções sob medida para integrar plataformas, sistemas e operações, tornando o seu negócio digital

## Expertise global, soluções sob medida

A **Devovea** é uma consultoria boutique dedicada a transformar visão em resultado. O nome vem do
latim e significa “*aplicar novas ideias a problemas práticos*”. Essa é a essência do nosso trabalho
em gestão de produtos, digital commerce e crescimento organizacional.
Por trás da Devovea está **Camilla Lichti**, líder com duas décadas de experiência em projetos
globais que apoia empresas e profissionais a destravar clareza estratégica, execução eficaz e
impacto real. Mais do que consultoria, oferecemos parceria próxima, com a flexibilidade e
profundidade de quem entende os desafios e oportunidades do seu negócio.

Somos Devovea
][23]

## Nossa Expertise, Seu Resultado

Áreas de atuação que unem estratégia, tecnologia e pessoas para impulsionar negócios e
profissionais. Cada projeto é conduzido com profundidade analítica, visão prática e compromisso em
gerar crescimento estruturado e sustentável.

impecável**.
Com projetos conduzidos em quatro continentes e mais de treze países, aplicamos conhecimento prático
de diferentes indústrias para promover crescimento estruturado e sustentável. Atuamos em toda a
jornada operacional, do marketing ao pós-venda, passando por atendimento, logística e fulfillment,
aprimorando a eficiência por meio de tecnologia, inteligência artificial e excelência em processos.

[
Explore nossa expertise
][24]

Guiamos empresas e líderes na construção de **estratégias de produto que conectam visão, propósito e
resultados mensuráveis**.
Atuamos desde o diagnóstico de maturidade até a definição da visão e da estratégia, fortalecendo
estruturas, processos e times. Nossa experiência inclui a liderança de equipes multiculturais com
mais de 30 profissionais em diferentes países, somada a uma trajetória sólida em Berlim, o epicentro
europeu de inovação, de onde exportamos tecnologia e boas práticas para diversos mercados.

Explore nossa expertise

estratégica, execução estruturada e resultados tangíveis.

## Expertise global, soluções sob medida

A **Devovea** é uma consultoria boutique dedicada a transformar visão em resultado. O nome vem do
latim e significa “*aplicar novas ideias a problemas práticos*”. Essa é a essência do nosso trabalho
em gestão de produtos, digital commerce e crescimento organizacional.
Por trás da Devovea está **Camilla Lichti**, líder com duas décadas de experiência em projetos
globais que apoia empresas e profissionais a destravar clareza estratégica, execução eficaz e
impacto real. Mais do que consultoria, oferecemos parceria próxima, com a flexibilidade e
profundidade de quem entende os desafios e oportunidades do seu negócio.

Somos Devovea

## Nossa Expertise, Seu Resultado

Áreas de atuação que unem estratégia, tecnologia e pessoas para impulsionar negócios e
profissionais. Cada projeto é conduzido com profundidade analítica, visão prática e compromisso em
gerar crescimento estruturado e sustentável.

### Digital Commerce

Desenvolvemos **operações digitais integradas que unem estratégia, tecnologia e execução
impecável**.
Com projetos conduzidos em quatro continentes e mais de treze países, aplicamos conhecimento prático
de diferentes indústrias para promover crescimento estruturado e sustentável. Atuamos em toda a
jornada operacional, do marketing ao pós-venda, passando por atendimento, logística e fulfillment,
aprimorando a eficiência por meio de tecnologia, inteligência artificial e excelência em processos.

Guiamos empresas e líderes na construção de **estratégias de produto que conectam visão, propósito e
resultados mensuráveis**.

estruturas, processos e times. Nossa experiência inclui a liderança de equipes multiculturais com
mais de 30 profissionais em diferentes países, somada a uma trajetória sólida em Berlim, o epicentro
europeu de inovação, de onde exportamos tecnologia e boas práticas para diversos mercados.

# From Hoping Things Work

[ Learn More about industries we serve ][44]

## To Knowing They Will

## EOSYS

### We Build the Brains Behind Manufacturing

You manage complex operations where trust matters and downtime isn't an option. We build integrated
systems that automate, streamline, and scale with you. You move faster, adapt smarter, and solve
problems with clarity. You stay ahead of the competition because you're built to lead, not lag.

[Contact Us][45]

[How We’re Different][46]


## Our Partners

### Best-In-Class Solutions Built for You

You know your goals. We bring the expertise to get you there. With a deep bench of specialists and
trusted partners, we align technology to your manufacturing needs so production stays reliable,
resilient, and ready for what’s next.

[Move Confidently With Our Team][47]

[ [logo for Rockwell Automation, the world's largest company devoted to industrial automation and
digital transformation] ][48]
[ [logo for Inductive Automation, a provider of SCADA software and industrial automation solutions]
][49]
[ [logo for Parsec Automation, a unified MES platform] ][50]
[ [logo for Foxboro by Schneider Electric, a high performance distributed control system designed to
monitor, control, and optimize industrial processes in real time] ][51]
[ [logo for IT consulting company Aveva] ][52]
[ [logo for Cisco Partners] ][53]
[ [logo for Stratus, a provider of high availability fault-tolerant edge computing servers, which
has now rebranded to Penguin Solutions as part of SGH] ][54]

## System Integration

### Let’s Turn Complexity into Clarity

Your goals guide every solution. We listen first, work beside you, then deliver automation and
digital systems that fit. No surprises. Just results that last.

[Conveyor on a production line featuring electronic computing chips colorized to resemble EOSYS
brand colors]

## Industrial Automation Solutions

### Speed. Clarity. Control. 
### That’s How You’ll Lead.

Your operation requires speed without sacrificing quality. We design automation and controls that
keep lines running, teams focused, and output consistent. No guesswork. Just systems that perform.

[Automation Solutions][55]

### Automation Solutions

#### Smarter Systems for Smarter Manufacturing

Brains, communication, and control built in, not bolted on.

[ Learn More about Automation Solutions ][56]

### Project Methodology

#### Removing Risk Before You Even Start

We sweat the details early so you don’t sweat at launch.

[ Learn More about Project Methodology ][57]

### OT Networks

#### Secure, Scalable, and Always Available

Everything talks, flows, and keeps running even when production changes or challenges arise.

[ Learn More about OT Networks ][58]
[Plant engineer inside an industrial facility wearing a hard hat holding a laptop with operational
data and system dashboards on the screen]

## Digital Transformation

### From Chaos to Clarity

Use your data to drive progress, not overwhelm your team. Close gaps, eliminate noise, and replace
spreadsheets with connected systems that reveal hidden opportunities. With real-time insights,
you’ll cut downtime, improve quality, and make confident decisions that move your business forward.

[Make the Shift With Digital Solutions][59]

### DX Accelerator™

#### Your Fast Track from Vision to Action

Our DX Accelerator turns strategy into systems. Teams align, priorities sharpen, and progress moves
fast.

# From Hoping Things Work

[ Learn More about industries we serve ][44]

## To Knowing They Will

## EOSYS

### We Build the Brains Behind Manufacturing

You manage complex operations where trust matters and downtime isn't an option. We build integrated
systems that automate, streamline, and scale with you. You move faster, adapt smarter, and solve
problems with clarity. You stay ahead of the competition because you're built to lead, not lag.

[Contact Us][45]

[How We’re Different][46]


## Our Partners

### Best-In-Class Solutions Built for You

You know your goals. We bring the expertise to get you there. With a deep bench of specialists and
trusted partners, we align technology to your manufacturing needs so production stays reliable,
resilient, and ready for what’s next.

[Move Confidently With Our Team][47]

[ [logo for Rockwell Automation, the world's largest company devoted to industrial automation and
digital transformation] ][48]
[ [logo for Inductive Automation, a provider of SCADA software and industrial automation solutions]
][49]
[ [logo for Parsec Automation, a unified MES platform] ][50]
[ [logo for Foxboro by Schneider Electric, a high performance distributed control system designed to
monitor, control, and optimize industrial processes in real time] ][51]
[ [logo for IT consulting company Aveva] ][52]
[ [logo for Cisco Partners] ][53]
[ [logo for Stratus, a provider of high availability fault-tolerant edge computing servers, which
has now rebranded to Penguin Solutions as part of SGH] ][54]

## System Integration

### Let’s Turn Complexity into Clarity

Your goals guide every solution. We listen first, work beside you, then deliver automation and
digital systems that fit. No surprises. Just results that last.

[Conveyor on a production line featuring electronic computing chips colorized to resemble EOSYS
brand colors]

## Industrial Automation Solutions

### Speed. Clarity. Control. 
### That’s How You’ll Lead.

Your operation requires speed without sacrificing quality. We design automation and controls that
keep lines running, teams focused, and output consistent. No guesswork. Just systems that perform.

[Automation Solutions][55]

### Automation Solutions

#### Smarter Systems for Smarter Manufacturing

Brains, communication, and control built in, not bolted on.

[ Learn More about Automation Solutions ][56]

### Project Methodology

#### Removing Risk Before You Even Start

We sweat the details early so you don’t sweat at launch.

[ Learn More about Project Methodology ][57]

### OT Networks

#### Secure, Scalable, and Always Available

Everything talks, flows, and keeps running even when production changes or challenges arise.

[ Learn More about OT Networks ][58]
[Plant engineer inside an industrial facility wearing a hard hat holding a laptop with operational
data and system dashboards on the screen]

## Digital Transformation

### From Chaos to Clarity

Use your data to drive progress, not overwhelm your team. Close gaps, eliminate noise, and replace
spreadsheets with connected systems that reveal hidden opportunities. With real-time insights,
you’ll cut downtime, improve quality, and make confident decisions that move your business forward.

[Make the Shift With Digital Solutions][59]

### DX Accelerator™

#### Your Fast Track from Vision to Action

Our DX Accelerator turns strategy into systems. Teams align, priorities sharpen, and progress moves
fast.

[ Learn More about DX Accelerator™ ][60]

### Project Methodology

#### The Backbone of Your Digital Transformation

This framework balances agility and governance, guiding you through change and focusing on
objectives.

[ Learn More about Project Methodology ][61]

### OT Networks

#### Your Foundation for a Safe, Scalable Digital Future

Strong, smart networks that never miss a beat, keeping production moving forward.

[ Learn More about OT Networks ][62]

## Industrial Panel Fabrication

### Confidence in Every Panel, Every Connection

Panel fabrication shouldn’t slow you down. You require quality panels built for dependable
performance, freeing you to tackle strategic challenges. We provide UL-listed, certified panels
custom-designed to your specifications.

[Explore Custom Panel Fabrication][63]

[Wiring inside an industrial control panel integrated with automation and operational systems]

## Industries

### Built to Meet the Demands of Your Industry

[View All Industries][64]

## Case Study

### Innovation Meets Legendary Craftsmanship

Just as tradition meets innovation in an iconic blend, Jack Daniel’s partnered with us to craft a
future-ready legacy. Together, we distilled real‑time data, automated quality checks, and elevated
collaboration. The result is smoother bottling, sharper insights, and a legendary brand poised to
lead the industry.

[Get the Full Story][74]

[logo for Jack Daniels, a distillery and bottling operation that hired EOSYS to develop and
integrate a system with real-time data, automated quality checks, and other features]

## Awards & Certifications

### Leading with Purpose

Accolades and trusted certifications reflect more than technical skill. They let you know you're in
good hands - with a team focused on driving exceptional performance for you and your business.

[EOSYS CSIA Member Ofthe Year]
[SI Hall of Fame Logo 1]

## Clear Steps to Your Success

Follow a proven process from concept to completion that keeps you in control and ready for
whatever’s next.

[Steps of our solution development process, including Chart the Course, Build the Solution,
Commission with Confidence, then Partner for the Future]

[Let's Get Started][75]

## About

### Your Success Is Our Business

You can count on us to be there for your success. That trust builds stronger operations, reduces
risks, and creates lasting impact. We've guided Fortune 500 and other leading manufacturers to
improved operations for over 30 years.

[Factory engineers wearing safety gear in an industrial setting while holding tablets and reviewing
operational data and system monitoring features]

##### **Our Customers Rate us Excellent**

As the global benchmark for customer satisfaction, earning an “Excellent” Net Promoter Score (NPS)
is tough. It means our clients trust us enough to recommend us, so you can feel confident you're
working with a proven partner.

#### What Makes EOSYS Unique

### Ownership in Every Decision

Your wins become our wins. That’s the power of employee-ownership, where everyone’s commitment has
been driving our collective success since 1991.

[ Learn More about Ownership in Every Decision ][76]

### From Shop Floor to Top Floor

We bridge the gap with systems that generate actionable insights at every level of your

[ Learn More about From Shop Floor to Top Floor ][77]

### Setting the Standards

We pursue technical excellence, setting higher bars for ourselves and our industry to deliver
superior solutions.

Get HackMD free][12]

## Your team has ideas,
## your agents have capabilities,
## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

## Millions build with HackMD's Markdown editor every day

Powering teams around the world, from next-generation startups to established institutions

## Built for the team, open to your agents

Your workspace, where humans collaborate and agents can keep up

#### Write together, think together, ship together

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][14]
* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.
[
See community stories][23]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

#### 1M+

Already powering over 1M+ API calls
Teams are using HackMD's API to feed their agents context, automate note creation, and keep
documentation in sync.
[
Read the API docs

### Digital transformation

We guide companies through their digital transformation journeys, providing tailored strategies and
software solutions that improve efficiency and automation.

[

##### ERP

We deliver comprehensive ERP systems that unify operations, streamline workflows, and ensure full
data visibility across the organization.

[

##### CRM

][75]

We implement tailored CRM systems to centralize client data, optimize sales and marketing processes,
and elevate customer engagement and satisfaction.

[Business process management]

##### Business process management

][76]

We design tailored BPM solutions to harmonize complex business operations, overcome process
bottlenecks, and improve operational efficiency.

[

##### Dynamics 365

][77]

A Microsoft Partner since 2008, we implement, and support Dynamics 365-based solutions that connect
departments, data, and business processes.

[

##### Odoo

][78]

As an Odoo Silver partner, we deliver flexible ERP systems based on Odoo to streamline
enterprise-wide workflows or selected business functions.

[

##### Salesforce

][79]

solutions to streamline customer-facing operations.

### Artificial intelligence

We help companies make smarter decisions and improve operational efficiency with [tailored AI
solutions][80].

##### AI agents

][81]

We design copilots and fully autonomous agents to handle repetitive business tasks like data
handling and customer service.

regulated and data-sensitive environments. Whether your obligations run to the [EU AI Act][90],
HIPAA, or SOC 2, we make compliance an engineering decision.
[ ][91]

06

### Intelligent edge

ITRex delivers end-to-end cyber-physical systems—from [electronics prototyping][92] and [sensor
integration][93] to [firmware engineering][94], [HMI design][95], and full [IoT solutions][96] and
[embedded system development][97]. Our [edge AI services][98] include deploying on-device LLMs and
SLMs on constrained hardware—bringing real-time inference and local data processing to environments
where cloud connectivity is limited, costly, or simply not an option.
[ ][99]

[
Gen AI chatbot for REDI: simplified access to cancer information →
A Gen AI chatbot for REDI (Ratner Early Detection Initiative), a nonprofit advancing cancer research
and early detection. Built on Claude 3.5 with a custom knowledge base, HIPAA-compliant prompt flows,
and adaptive responses for both medical and lay audiences—delivered in three weeks. Users now get
research-backed answers on screenings, symptoms, and risk factors in real time, with every response
tied to vetted sources.
][100]
[
WorkFusion: intelligent automation & AI agent implementation for financial crime compliance (FCC) →
AI agents for WorkFusion's financial crime compliance platform, now used by four of the top five US
and EU banks. ITRex built NLP models to extract, classify, and assess unstructured web data across
adverse media monitoring and sanctions screening—with a built-in explanation system that gives human
analysts clear reasoning behind every automated recommendation. The agents handle 60–70% of
compliance-related manual work.
][101]

tickets, voice prompts with live transcription, and natural-language dashboard access—then
implemented it in Vue.js with WebSocket-based communication for real-time responsiveness. Onboarding

to date.

media flow, mechanical stress parameters, and real-time pressure and temperature

analytics. The platform has since been adopted by 100+ labs, including top pharmaceutical companies

# Oliver Holzmann

[Email: oliver@oliverholzmann.com][6]
* [[LinkedIn]][7]

I come from inside culture, not theory.


My career began on the edge - as a professional snowboarder, where performance and credibility were
everything. 


I carried that mindset through nearly twenty years at Red Bull, where I helped build one of the most
culturally influential brands of the modern era.


Later, I led global marketing at Black Diamond and served as CMO of Gorilla Energy across 29
markets.


Today, I focus on brands at defining growth moments, when positioning determines whether a company
simply scales or becomes iconic.


I work with founders and CEOs who need that clarity now. Through [MANNNN][8], I advise leadership
teams on positioning, growth strategy, and brand direction.


I also take on a small number of fractional CMO engagements when sustained, hands-on involvement is
required.

[Oliver Holzmann]

## WHERE I ADD LEVERAGE

Brand Strategy & Identity
Positioning, narrative, and brand architecture at scale.

 

Growth & Go-to-Market Direction
Market entry, brand evolution, and disciplined expansion.

 

Culture-Led Marketing
Building credibility through sport, culture, influencer, community, and participation.

 

Leadership & Alignment
Aligning teams, partners, and stakeholders around clear direction.

 

Global Brand Stewardship
Scaling brands across markets without dilution of meaning.

01

## Professional Athlete

I’ve been a professional snowboarding athlete and ranked consistently among the world's top ten in
the halfpipe discipline and freestyle overall.

[Snowboard Proefssional ]

02

## Career Maker - Sports & Entertainment Agent

I played a pivotal role in launching the careers of internationally acclaimed athletes & artists,
including four-time F1 world champion Sebastian Vettel, fostering lasting relationships that endure
to this day.

[Sebastian Vettel]

03

## Visionary Thinker & Executor

I orchestrated the conception, development, and execution of several landmark projects and
events for major brands around the world within the realms of sports and entertainment, leaving an
indelible mark on both industries. 

[Iconic Projects]

04

## Analyst and Strategist

I crafted and implemented enduring national and global strategies encompassing entertainment,
sports, and overarching brand initiatives, which continue to shape the landscape of our industry
today.

[Full Funnel Campaigns]

05

## Cross Cultural Leader and Communicator

I've had the privilege of living, working, and leading teams across six continents, immersing myself
in diverse cultural landscapes spanning Europe, Asia, Latin America, Africa, and North America.

[Leadership Training]

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

2025 - YTD


### Chief Marketing Officer | Fractional since 2026

Gorilla Energy

   Dubai, UAE | Los Angeles, CA 

 

* Defined and deployed a globally unified brand architecture and positioning platform

* Led global full-funnel SKU launches, with one innovation becoming a top-three product worldwide
  within six months

* Oversees marketing across 29 markets and directs market entry for the U.S., Turkey, and UAE,
  anchored by a flagship Dubai launch generating 235M+ media impressions and $5M+ in earned media
  value

* Built a scalable global marketing operating model, contributing to 25%+ global growth through
  disciplined brand leadership

RESUME

Stay-at-home dad

In fall of 2023 we welcomed our daughter Ariana

2024

Black Diamond Equipment

Salt Lake City, UT.

* Directed global athlete, event, content, and social strategy, aligned with a DTC-first

# IGNITE COFFEE’S FUTURE

[Get to know the SCA][106]

COFFEE BUSINESS EDUCATION

## You already know coffee. Now learn the business.

A new 12-week, online, cohort program designed to help coffee shop owners and managers level up
their business — from launch to growth. Built for working professionals, by tenured experts.

[Learn more][107]

EDUCATION

## Grow your coffee career with the SCA

The SCA offers globally recognized coffee education designed to support career growth at every
level. From foundational learning to advanced certifications, these courses are used by coffee
professionals and businesses worldwide.

[Start learning][108]
**80,000+ LEARNERS/YEAR** 89 COUNTRIES **2,000+ AUTHORIZED SCA TRAINERS** 16 SKILLS-BASED MODULES
**4 CAREER-DRIVEN DIPLOMAS** 80,000+ LEARNERS/YEAR **89 COUNTRIES** 2,000+ AUTHORIZED SCA TRAINERS
**16 SKILLS-BASED MODULES** 4 CAREER-DRIVEN DIPLOMAS

JUST ANNOUNCED

## Introducing Master of Specialty Coffee

A credential designed for the professionals who have spent their careers working across every
dimension of this industry.

The highest distinction in coffee.

[Learn more][109]
[SCA CEO stands with representatives of the Seoul coffee community at launch event for Master of
Specialty Coffee in May 2026]

### More programs to grow your skills

**Gain skills with SCA diplomas**

Structured learning across key areas of specialty coffee.

[Learn more][110]

**Get a Q Grader License**

Certification focused on coffee quality evaluation and cupping.

[Learn more][111]

**Learn with Coffee Business Education**

Training designed for coffee shop owners and business operators.

[Learn more][112]

SCA EVENTS

## Find coffee events
## around the world

SCA events include World of Coffee, World Coffee Championships, and global industry gatherings.
These events bring professionals together to connect, compete, and stay updated on the new products
and latest developments in coffee.

[Explore events][113]

WORLD COFFEE CHAMPIONSHIPS

## Three New
## World Champions!

Find out more about the newly crowned best brewer, roaster and coffee mixologists.

[ Learn more][114]

### Upcoming events across the globe

  October 23 - 25, 2026
  Calle Gral. Juan D. Peron,
  Panam

# IGNITE COFFEE’S FUTURE

[Get to know the SCA][106]

COFFEE BUSINESS EDUCATION

## You already know coffee. Now learn the business.

A new 12-week, online, cohort program designed to help coffee shop owners and managers level up
their business — from launch to growth. Built for working professionals, by tenured experts.

[Learn more][107]

EDUCATION

## Grow your coffee career with the SCA

The SCA offers globally recognized coffee education designed to support career growth at every
level. From foundational learning to advanced certifications, these courses are used by coffee
professionals and businesses worldwide.

[Start learning][108]
**80,000+ LEARNERS/YEAR** 89 COUNTRIES **2,000+ AUTHORIZED SCA TRAINERS** 16 SKILLS-BASED MODULES
**4 CAREER-DRIVEN DIPLOMAS** 80,000+ LEARNERS/YEAR **89 COUNTRIES** 2,000+ AUTHORIZED SCA TRAINERS
**16 SKILLS-BASED MODULES** 4 CAREER-DRIVEN DIPLOMAS

JUST ANNOUNCED

## Introducing Master of Specialty Coffee

A credential designed for the professionals who have spent their careers working across every
dimension of this industry.

The highest distinction in coffee.

[Learn more][109]
[SCA CEO stands with representatives of the Seoul coffee community at launch event for Master of
Specialty Coffee in May 2026]

### More programs to grow your skills

**Gain skills with SCA diplomas**

Structured learning across key areas of specialty coffee.

[Learn more][110]

**Get a Q Grader License**

Certification focused on coffee quality evaluation and cupping.

[Learn more][111]

**Learn with Coffee Business Education**

Training designed for coffee shop owners and business operators.

[Learn more][112]

SCA EVENTS

## Find coffee events
## around the world

SCA events include World of Coffee, World Coffee Championships, and global industry gatherings.
These events bring professionals together to connect, compete, and stay updated on the new products
and latest developments in coffee.

[Explore events][113]

WORLD COFFEE CHAMPIONSHIPS

## Three New
## World Champions!

Find out more about the newly crowned best brewer, roaster and coffee mixologists.

[ Learn more][114]

### Upcoming events across the globe
* ## World of Coffee Panama
  
  October 23 - 25, 2026
  Calle Gral. Juan D. Peron,
  Panam

# Neoncorte Bio -Revolutionizing Biomolecule Engineering with AI

At **Neoncorte Bio**, we harness the power of artificial intelligence and advanced protein language
models to transform enzyme engineering, protein design, aptamer discovery, and antibody development.
Our cutting-edge software and tools accelerate research and development, streamline experimental
workflows, and unlock new possibilities in therapeutics, diagnostics, industrial biotechnology, and
beyond.
[ai driven enzyme engineering company neoncorte bio]

## Our Solutions
* ## Aptamer Design & Discovery
  
  **High-Affinity Aptamers:** Generate nucleic acid-based ligands with superior binding specificity
  for diagnostics and therapeutics.
  
  **AI-Enhanced Screening:** Use advanced algorithms to sift through vast sequence libraries and
  identify optimal aptamer candidates.
  
  **Custom Solutions:** Tailor aptamer designs to target biomarkers, pathogens, or industrial
  compounds.
* ## Advanced Protein Engineering
  
  **Custom Protein Design:** Create novel proteins or optimize existing ones for therapeutic
  efficacy, industrial processes, and research.
  
  **Precision Modelling:** Utilize deep learning and protein language models to simulate structure,
  function, and interactions.
  
  **Accelerated Discovery:** Integrate AI-driven insights to bring breakthrough protein products to
  market faster.
* ## AI-Powered Enzyme Engineering
  
  **Optimize Catalysis:** Design enzymes with enhanced stability, activity, and specificity for
  industrial and pharmaceutical applications.
  
  **Sustainable Biocatalysts:** Replace harsh chemicals with eco-friendly, bioengineered enzymes.
  
  **Rapid Development:** Leverage protein language models to predict enzyme function and reduce R&D
  cycles.
* ## Antibody Discovery & Optimization
  
  **De Novo Antibody Design:** Employ AI to create antibodies from scratch with enhanced affinity
  and lower immunogenicity.
  
  **Bispecific & Multispecific Formats:** Innovate next-generation antibody therapeutics for
  oncology, autoimmunity, and infectious diseases.
  
  **Data-Driven Selection:** Accelerate candidate identification and optimization using predictive
  modeling and simulation.

[Neoncorte Bio AI/ML protein and enzyme engineering solutions company]

## Industries We Serve
* Accelerate drug discovery and development with optimized enzymes, proteins, and antibodies
  
  ## Pharmaceuticals & Therapeutics
* Empower breakthrough scientific discoveries with customizable, AI-driven biomolecule design
  
  ## Research & Academia
* Enhance processes in biofuels, food processing, and sustainable manufacturing
  
  ## Industrial Biotechnology
* Improve diagnostic assay sensitivity and specificity with AI-designed aptamers and antibodies
  
  ## Diagnostics

## Technologies

We combine Artificial Intelligence with computational infrastructure and integrate protein & enzyme
data to ease your experience
* AI & Machine Learning
  Our proprietary AI algorithms predict enzyme behavior with unmatched accuracy. By leveraging
  machine learning, we identify optimal mutations and streamline the enzyme design process
* High-Performance Computing
  Our state-of-the-art computational infrastructure allows us to simulate complex molecular
  dynamics, ensuring that our enzyme designs are not only theoretically sound but also practically
  viable
* Data Integration
  We integrate data from multiple sources, including our enzyme database, scientific literature, and
  experimental results, to create a comprehensive model of enzyme functionality

[ [Neoncorte Bio AI/ML protein enzyme engineering solution in silico mutational scanning tool] ][11]

## Powered by Protein Language Models

Our platform is built on state-of-the-art protein language models that understand the “language of
proteins.” By analyzing millions of protein sequences and structures, our AI algorithms learn
underlying patterns and functional motifs, enabling:
* ## Accurate predictions
  
  of protein behavior and stability
* ## Enhanced design capabilities
  
  that overcome the limitations of traditional methods
* ## Streamlined discovery
  
  by quickly generating high-quality biomolecule candidates for experimental validation.

## **Neoncorte Bio**

Where AI Meets Biotechnology
Neoncorte Bio is at the forefront of the convergence between artificial intelligence and protein &
enzyme engineering. Our team comprises experts in computational biology, bioinformatics, and machine
learning, all driven by a mission to accelerate innovation in enzyme design. By leveraging our
advanced AI models, we provide unparalleled solutions that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and
push the boundaries of what's possible in protein engineering & enzyme engineering

## Proud Member of Leading Global AI Programs

Neoncorte Bio is part of the NVIDIA Inception and Nebius for Startups programs — two of the world’s
leading ecosystems for high-performance AI innovation. These partnerships strengthen our ability to
deliver next-generation AI-driven protein, enzyme, and aptamer engineering.
* [NVIDIA Inception Neoncorte Bio AI life sciences company]
  As a member of NVIDIA Inception, Neoncorte Bio gains access to cutting-edge GPU technologies,
  expert guidance, and a global AI ecosystem that supports companies from prototype to production.
  The program empowers us to explore new AI opportunities and build high-performance biological
  design pipelines powered by NVIDIA’s world-class platform.
* [Nebius AI life sciences Neoncorte Bio ]
  Through Nebius for Startups, we gain access to high-performance compute infrastructure optimized
  for large-scale AI workloads, along with hands-on technical guidance and a strong community of
  innovative AI companies. Nebius enables us to train and deploy complex biological models more
  efficiently — accelerating enzyme, protein, and aptamer design while supporting rapid scaling of
  our R&D pipelines.

## Publications

Explore our contributions to the forefront of biotechnology and artificial intelligence. From
AI-driven enzyme engineering to deep learning applications in data analysis, our publications
highlight innovative solutions to complex challenges in molecular biology and computational science.
* [Enhancing the Reverse Transcriptase Function in Taq Polymerase via AI-driven Multiparametric
  Rational Design. July 2024][13]
  Modification of natural enzymes to introduce new properties and enhance existing ones is a central
  challenge in bioengineering. This study is focused on the development of Taq polymerase mutants
  that show enhanced reverse transcriptase (RTase) activity while retaining other desirable
  properties such as fidelity, 5′-3′ exonuclease activity, effective deoxyuracil incorporation, and
  tolerance to locked nucleic acid (LNA)-containing substrates.
* [Rectangular knot diagrams classification with deep learning, October 2022][14]
  The transcriptomic data are being frequently used in the research of biomarker genes of different
  diseases and biological states. The most common tasks there are the data harmonization and
  treatment outcome prediction. Both of them can be addressed via the style transfer approach.
  Either technical factors or any biological details about the samples which we would like to
  control (gender, biological state, treatment, etc.) can be used as style components.
* [All publications][15]
  List of all Neoncorte Bio publications dedicated to Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Artificial
  Intelligence and Artificial Neural Networks, published mostly by Nikolay Russkikh, CEO of
  Neoncorte Bio
  
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What services does Neoncorte Bio provide?
We offer a comprehensive suite of AI-powered solutions for enzyme engineering, protein engineering,
aptamer design, and antibody discovery. Our platform leverages advanced machine learning and
computational modeling to accelerate biomolecule design, optimize performance, and reduce R&D time
and costs across multiple industries—including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, diagnostics, and
industrial applications.
Who can benefit from your solutions?
Our services are designed for biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, academic research labs,
diagnostics developers, CROs, and industrial manufacturers. Whether you’re developing novel enzymes
for sustainable processing, designing therapeutic proteins, discovering aptamers for diagnostics, or
engineering antibodies for immunotherapy, our solutions can help streamline and enhance your R&D
processes.
How does your AI-powered platform work?
Our platform integrates deep learning algorithms, molecular dynamics simulations, and data-driven
predictive modeling. You provide the input—such as target sequences, structural data, and desired
functionalities—and our system generates a library of candidate biomolecules. We then rank these
candidates based on predicted activity, stability, specificity, and manufacturability, giving you a
highly curated list for further experimental validation.
What types of molecules can your platform engineer?
We specialize in:
* **Enzymes:** Optimizing catalytic efficiency, stability, and substrate specificity for industrial,
  pharmaceutical, or environmental applications.
* **Proteins: **Designing novel therapeutic proteins and optimizing existing proteins for improved
  performance.
* **Aptamers: **Creating high-affinity, highly specific nucleic acid-based ligands for diagnostics
  and therapeutics.
* **Antibodies: **De novo design and optimization of monoclonal, bispecific, and antibody fragment
  formats for various medical applications.
What sets your technology apart from traditional methods?
Unlike conventional trial-and-error or purely rational design approaches, our AI-driven platform
rapidly screens vast sequence spaces, identifies high-potential candidates, and continuously learns
from experimental feedback. This leads to:
* Faster discovery cycles.
* Reduced laboratory costs.
* Enhanced prediction accuracy for binding and functionality.
* The ability to design biomolecules that would be difficult or impossible to develop with
  traditional methods.
 Can your solution be customized to our specific research needs?
Absolutely. We tailor our algorithms and workflows to match your unique targets, data sets, and
process requirements. Whether you need a custom enzyme for a specific industrial process or a
bespoke antibody for a therapeutic indication, we work closely with you to adjust parameters and
integrate proprietary data for optimal results.
How does your platform integrate with existing lab workflows?
Our solution features robust API support and flexible data export options (e.g., CSV, JSON) to
seamlessly integrate with your Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), data analytics
pipelines, and even automation platforms. We also provide full onboarding and technical training to
ensure smooth adoption by your team.
How reliable are your AI predictions?
Our AI models are built on extensive datasets from published research, experimental data, and
industry collaborations. Continuous validation and refinement using in vitro and in vivo data ensure
our predictions are highly accurate. While our computational predictions provide a strong
foundation, we recommend experimental validation to confirm performance under your specific
conditions.

  **De Novo Antibody Design:** Employ AI to create antibodies from scratch with enhanced affinity
  and lower immunogenicity.
  
  **Bispecific & Multispecific Formats:** Innovate next-generation antibody therapeutics for
  oncology, autoimmunity, and infectious diseases.
  
  **Data-Driven Selection:** Accelerate candidate identification and optimization using predictive
  modeling and simulation.

[Neoncorte Bio AI/ML protein and enzyme engineering solutions company]

## Industries We Serve
* Accelerate drug discovery and development with optimized enzymes, proteins, and antibodies
  
  ## Pharmaceuticals & Therapeutics
* Empower breakthrough scientific discoveries with customizable, AI-driven biomolecule design
  
  ## Research & Academia
* Enhance processes in biofuels, food processing, and sustainable manufacturing
  
  ## Industrial Biotechnology
* Improve diagnostic assay sensitivity and specificity with AI-designed aptamers and antibodies
  
  ## Diagnostics

## Technologies

We combine Artificial Intelligence with computational infrastructure and integrate protein & enzyme
data to ease your experience
* AI & Machine Learning
  Our proprietary AI algorithms predict enzyme behavior with unmatched accuracy. By leveraging
  machine learning, we identify optimal mutations and streamline the enzyme design process
* High-Performance Computing
  Our state-of-the-art computational infrastructure allows us to simulate complex molecular
  dynamics, ensuring that our enzyme designs are not only theoretically sound but also practically
  viable
* Data Integration
  We integrate data from multiple sources, including our enzyme database, scientific literature, and
  experimental results, to create a comprehensive model of enzyme functionality
[Optimization of cellulase variants Neoncorte Bio AI/ML protein enzyme engineering company]
[ [Neoncorte Bio AI/ML protein enzyme engineering solution in silico mutational scanning tool] ][11]

## Powered by Protein Language Models

Our platform is built on state-of-the-art protein language models that understand the “language of
proteins.” By analyzing millions of protein sequences and structures, our AI algorithms learn
underlying patterns and functional motifs, enabling:
* ## Accurate predictions
  
  of protein behavior and stability
* ## Enhanced design capabilities
  
  that overcome the limitations of traditional methods
* ## Streamlined discovery
  
  by quickly generating high-quality biomolecule candidates for experimental validation.

## Ready to transform your biomolecule discovery process?

Let’s collaborate to make protein & enzyme R&D faster, cheaper, and more effective

[Book a meeting ][12]

## **Neoncorte Bio**

Where AI Meets Biotechnology
Neoncorte Bio is at the forefront of the convergence between artificial intelligence and protein &
enzyme engineering. Our team comprises experts in computational biology, bioinformatics, and machine
learning, all driven by a mission to accelerate innovation in enzyme design. By leveraging our
advanced AI models, we provide unparalleled solutions that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and
push the boundaries of what's possible in protein engineering & enzyme engineering

## Proud Member of Leading Global AI Programs

Neoncorte Bio is part of the NVIDIA Inception and Nebius for Startups programs — two of the world’s
leading ecosystems for high-performance AI innovation. These partnerships strengthen our ability to
deliver next-generation AI-driven protein, enzyme, and aptamer engineering.
* [NVIDIA Inception Neoncorte Bio AI life sciences company]
  As a member of NVIDIA Inception, Neoncorte Bio gains access to cutting-edge GPU technologies,
  expert guidance, and a global AI ecosystem that supports companies from prototype to production.
  The program empowers us to explore new AI opportunities and build high-performance biological
  design pipelines powered by NVIDIA’s world-class platform.
* [Nebius AI life sciences Neoncorte Bio ]
  Through Nebius for Startups, we gain access to high-performance compute infrastructure optimized
  for large-scale AI workloads, along with hands-on technical guidance and a strong community of
  innovative AI companies. Nebius enables us to train and deploy complex biological models more
  efficiently — accelerating enzyme, protein, and aptamer design while supporting rapid scaling of
  our R&D pipelines.

## Publications

Explore our contributions to the forefront of biotechnology and artificial intelligence. From
AI-driven enzyme engineering to deep learning applications in data analysis, our publications
highlight innovative solutions to complex challenges in molecular biology and computational science.
* [Enhancing the Reverse Transcriptase Function in Taq Polymerase via AI-driven Multiparametric
  Rational Design. July 2024][13]
  Modification of natural enzymes to introduce new properties and enhance existing ones is a central
  challenge in bioengineering. This study is focused on the development of Taq polymerase mutants
  that show enhanced reverse transcriptase (RTase) activity while retaining other desirable
  properties such as fidelity, 5′-3′ exonuclease activity, effective deoxyuracil incorporation, and
  tolerance to locked nucleic acid (LNA)-containing substrates.
* [Rectangular knot diagrams classification with deep learning, October 2022][14]
  The transcriptomic data are being frequently used in the research of biomarker genes of different
  diseases and biological states. The most common tasks there are the data harmonization and
  treatment outcome prediction. Both of them can be addressed via the style transfer approach.
  Either technical factors or any biological details about the samples which we would like to
  control (gender, biological state, treatment, etc.) can be used as style components.
* [All publications][15]
  List of all Neoncorte Bio publications dedicated to Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Artificial
  Intelligence and Artificial Neural Networks, published mostly by Nikolay Russkikh, CEO of
  Neoncorte Bio
  
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
What services does Neoncorte Bio provide?
We offer a comprehensive suite of AI-powered solutions for enzyme engineering, protein engineering,
aptamer design, and antibody discovery. Our platform leverages advanced machine learning and
computational modeling to accelerate biomolecule design, optimize performance, and reduce R&D time
and costs across multiple industries—including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, diagnostics, and
industrial applications.
Who can benefit from your solutions?
Our services are designed for biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, academic research labs,
diagnostics developers, CROs, and industrial manufacturers. Whether you’re developing novel enzymes
for sustainable processing, designing therapeutic proteins, discovering aptamers for diagnostics, or
engineering antibodies for immunotherapy, our solutions can help streamline and enhance your R&D
processes.
How does your AI-powered platform work?
Our platform integrates deep learning algorithms, molecular dynamics simulations, and data-driven
predictive modeling. You provide the input—such as target sequences, structural data, and desired
functionalities—and our system generates a library of candidate biomolecules. We then rank these
candidates based on predicted activity, stability, specificity, and manufacturability, giving you a
highly curated list for further experimental validation.
What types of molecules can your platform engineer?
We specialize in:
* **Enzymes:** Optimizing catalytic efficiency, stability, and substrate specificity for industrial,
  pharmaceutical, or environmental applications.
* **Proteins: **Designing novel therapeutic proteins and optimizing existing proteins for improved
  performance.
* **Aptamers: **Creating high-affinity, highly specific nucleic acid-based ligands for diagnostics
  and therapeutics.
* **Antibodies: **De novo design and optimization of monoclonal, bispecific, and antibody fragment
  formats for various medical applications.
What sets your technology apart from traditional methods?
Unlike conventional trial-and-error or purely rational design approaches, our AI-driven platform
rapidly screens vast sequence spaces, identifies high-potential candidates, and continuously learns
from experimental feedback. This leads to:
* Faster discovery cycles.
* Reduced laboratory costs.
* Enhanced prediction accuracy for binding and functionality.
* The ability to design biomolecules that would be difficult or impossible to develop with
  traditional methods.
 Can your solution be customized to our specific research needs?
Absolutely. We tailor our algorithms and workflows to match your unique targets, data sets, and
process requirements. Whether you need a custom enzyme for a specific industrial process or a
bespoke antibody for a therapeutic indication, we work closely with you to adjust parameters and
integrate proprietary data for optimal results.
How does your platform integrate with existing lab workflows?
Our solution features robust API support and flexible data export options (e.g., CSV, JSON) to
seamlessly integrate with your Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), data analytics
pipelines, and even automation platforms. We also provide full onboarding and technical training to
ensure smooth adoption by your team.
How reliable are your AI predictions?
Our AI models are built on extensive datasets from published research, experimental data, and
industry collaborations. Continuous validation and refinement using in vitro and in vivo data ensure
our predictions are highly accurate. While our computational predictions provide a strong
foundation, we recommend experimental validation to confirm performance under your specific
conditions.

Passion is clearly necessary for a truly great idea to take hold among a people—passion on the part
of the original thinker, of the public, or ideally both. The claim that the most fruitful subject
for inspiring great ideas is "ordinary things" may at first seem counterintuitive. After all, aren't
great ideas usually marked by their extraordinary character? While this is true, their extraordinary
character often derives directly from their insight into things that had until then gone
unquestioned. Although great ideas can certainly arise through an innovation that seems purely
original... take, for example, Big Bang cosmology, which developed nearly all of its own scientific
and philosophical premises through its own process of formation, it is equally true that such
innovative thinking was, and still is, largely a reassessment of earlier assumptions in a radical
way... After all, the question of the ultimate nature of the universe and of humanity's place within
it has been central to human thought since the dawn of time. Ordinary things are, additionally,
necessary as raw material for generating the "best ideas," since surely success with the public must
be taken into account when assessing the importance and quality of an idea. The advent of Big Bang
cosmology, which arose in rudimentary form almost immediately after Edwin Hubble's first
observations through the Hooker telescope in California in the early 20th century, was the most
significant advance in humanity's understanding of the universe in more than 400 years. The
seemingly simple fact that everything in the universe, on a very large scale, is moving away from
