## Frequently Asked Questions

What does turian do?

turian automates the processing of sales orders, quote requests, bills of quantities, supplier order
confirmations so that mid-market manufacturers, distributors, and wholesalers can handle more volume
without adding headcount. turian reads incoming documents in any format, matches them against the
company's ERP master data, and creates structured records automatically. Human team members review
and approve outputs rather than processing documents from scratch.

Which ERP systems does turian integrate with?

turian integrates with SAP Business One, SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft
Dynamics AX, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, Infor LN, Infor M3, ProAlpha, Oracle NetSuite, Sage X3, and
Odoo. The integration reads customer master data, product master data, and pricing conditions from
the ERP to validate incoming documents, and writes confirmed records directly to the ERP without a
manual import step.

How long does it take to implement turian?

turian implementations typically take four to six weeks from kickoff to live processing. We offer a
proof of concept using historical documents from the customer's own order mix, so accuracy is
validated before any live connection is made. There is no training data requirement: turian's
LLM-based matching works from day one without a labeled document set. turian's implementation team
manages the deployment; no system integrator is required.

Is turian GDPR compliant?

Yes. turian processes and stores data in EU-based infrastructure, holds ISO 27001 certification, and
provides a GDPR-compliant Data Processing Agreement as standard. Customer data is not used to train
external models.

What is the difference between turian and traditional OCR or RPA tools?

Traditional OCR and RPA tools require a configured template for each customer's document format and
break when that format changes. turian uses large language models to interpret document content
semantically, which means it handles any document format without prior configuration, processes
documents in any language, and matches products from customer descriptions without requiring the
customer to use the supplier's internal product codes. This makes turian applicable to the full
range of real-world B2B document variety, not only to structured, predictable inputs.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What does turian do?

turian automates the processing of sales orders, quote requests, bills of quantities, supplier order
confirmations so that mid-market manufacturers, distributors, and wholesalers can handle more volume
without adding headcount. turian reads incoming documents in any format, matches them against the
company's ERP master data, and creates structured records automatically. Human team members review
and approve outputs rather than processing documents from scratch.

Which ERP systems does turian integrate with?

turian integrates with SAP Business One, SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft
Dynamics AX, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, Infor LN, Infor M3, ProAlpha, Oracle NetSuite, Sage X3, and
Odoo. The integration reads customer master data, product master data, and pricing conditions from
the ERP to validate incoming documents, and writes confirmed records directly to the ERP without a
manual import step.

How long does it take to implement turian?

turian implementations typically take four to six weeks from kickoff to live processing. We offer a
proof of concept using historical documents from the customer's own order mix, so accuracy is
validated before any live connection is made. There is no training data requirement: turian's
LLM-based matching works from day one without a labeled document set. turian's implementation team
manages the deployment; no system integrator is required.

Is turian GDPR compliant?

Yes. turian processes and stores data in EU-based infrastructure, holds ISO 27001 certification, and
provides a GDPR-compliant Data Processing Agreement as standard. Customer data is not used to train
external models.

What is the difference between turian and traditional OCR or RPA tools?

Traditional OCR and RPA tools require a configured template for each customer's document format and
break when that format changes. turian uses large language models to interpret document content
semantically, which means it handles any document format without prior configuration, processes
documents in any language, and matches products from customer descriptions without requiring the
customer to use the supplier's internal product codes. This makes turian applicable to the full
range of real-world B2B document variety, not only to structured, predictable inputs.

# Independent Ecommerce & Digital Marketing Consultancy

## eCommerce. Marketing. Leadership — Delivered.

I help ambitious brands unlock their next stage of growth by stepping in as a fractional ecommerce
and marketing leader. Whether you’re navigating change, scaling quickly, or need senior support
without the overhead, I bring the strategic leadership and hands-on expertise to keep momentum high
and results on track.

With over 15 years’ experience across digital marketing and ecommerce — particularly in the wine,
drinks, and lifestyle sectors — I’ve worked with businesses of all sizes to build, grow, and
optimise. From performance marketing (Google Ads, Meta), Shopify development, and CRM strategy to
team structure and customer journey design, I combine commercial thinking with creative execution to
deliver meaningful impact.

In interim roles, I lead ecommerce and marketing teams on a part-time basis — assessing what’s
working (and what’s not), building a clear roadmap, shaping the right team structure, and handing
over once everything’s running smoothly.

Alongside these embedded roles, I also offer tailored packages focused on specific areas of
marketing — from Google Ads and Meta campaign management to ecommerce audits and strategic planning.
These can run as standalone retainers or bolt-ons to broader workstreams. I also provide training
and mentoring for in-house teams, helping to upskill talent and embed capability where it’s needed
most.

Based just outside Shrewsbury in Shropshire, I work with both local and national businesses. While I
often deliver work directly, I also collaborate with a trusted group of associates to scale support
flexibly. This isn’t an agency setup — it’s a practical, collaborative model designed to give you
the right expertise at the right time.

Whether you need help leading a team, unlocking performance in your marketing channels, or building
a foundation for sustainable growth, I bring the clarity, experience, and energy to help you move
forward — with confidence and control.

From £50 per hour

Choosing the right eCommerce platform is critical to your brand’s success. I offer independent
advice to guide you through platform selection, setup, and long-term planning. Whether you're
starting from scratch or scaling an existing operation, I’ll help you avoid costly mistakes and
build a roadmap aligned to your goals. With deep experience across Shopify and broader ecosystems, I
deliver tailored strategies that put your brand, your customers, and your profitability first.

#### Shopify Builds, Migrations & Optimisation

Full builds from £1495

Your Shopify site should be more than just a shopfront — it should be a growth engine. I manage
complete Shopify builds, redesigns, and migrations with a focus on performance, user experience, and
conversion. Whether you need a brand-new store, a site migration without losing SEO equity, or
ongoing optimisation to increase sales, I deliver clean, scalable solutions. Every build is designed
to be as functional as it is beautiful, empowering your business to thrive.

#### Process Improvement & Site Performance Audits

Site audits from £245

A smooth, high-performing website starts behind the scenes. I audit your site, systems, and
workflows to identify friction points that could be costing you sales. From checkout optimisation to
operational efficiency, I uncover areas for improvement and deliver clear, actionable
recommendations. Whether you need a one-off site audit or a full process transformation plan, I help
you create a seamless customer journey and a backend operation that supports sustainable growth.

# Marketing Services

#### Paid Advertising

From £295 per channel per month

I create and manage high-performing ad campaigns across Google PPC, Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
Ads, and Amazon Ads. Every campaign is designed to drive qualified traffic, maximise return on ad
spend, and grow your brand. Whether you're launching new products, building brand awareness, or
scaling an existing store, I combine data-driven targeting with creative execution to deliver real,
measurable results. From setup to ongoing optimisation, I manage the process so you can focus on
running your business.

From £50 per hour

Email remains one of the highest-ROI marketing channels — but only when done right. I build

your customers and increase lifetime value. From welcome series to abandoned cart recovery and
promotions, I help you turn subscribers into loyal buyers. Every email strategy is tailored to your
brand tone and customer journey, designed to strengthen relationships, drive repeat sales, and grow
